desc:
Make a Story with Friends! 📝 – the classic folded paper story game!

Sit at a table with friends, pick a category and write a line without seeing what came before. Fold, pass, and after 5-8-12 lines every story is read out loud. The results are hilarious!

🎮 FEATURES:

Multiple story categories
Fart on other players, or the whole server, and get your revenge!
Daily rewards and free items
Collect chair, paper and pencil skins
Spectate other tables and watch players type live
